[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips to combat dry skin during winter:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Exfoliate once or twice a week to remove dead skin cells.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Apply moisturizer immediately after bathing or showering while skin is still damp.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Wear gloves and socks to bed to lock in moisture.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Avoid hot water and harsh soaps.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water.
